notes.title: Upcoming Closed and Open Beta Announcements
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

Today we are very excited to reveal the Closed and Open Beta dates for Scuffed Party. In this blog post we will be discussing when exactly the beta is and what the beta will contain.

[u][b]Closed Beta[/b][/u]
The closed beta will take place from the 5th of November at 12am EST to the 12th of November at 12am EST, this will contain one map. Which is Pog City. 

The Closed Beta will be a stripped down version of the full game, with the only mode available being Offline Party Mode with One Map available, with 6 being available at launch.

In order to get access, you can request access. We will be taking 100-200 participants, or more depending on how many of you guys are applying to get positions.

[u][b]Open Beta[/b][/u]
The Open Beta launches as soon as the Closed Beta ends. The Open Beta will go from the 12th of November 12am EST to the 19th of November 12am EST.

This Open Beta will slightly differ from the Closed, We will offer 2 Maps on Board Game mode instead of One. And we will also be offering technical previews of our Party Modes, which we will be revealing closer to the open beta launch.

If you have any questions, please feel free to respond to this blog post or use the Scuffed Party Discussions board.

Thanks and we look forward to sharing the Scuffed Party Open Beta with you all on the 12th!
- Shanaz
